|strategy=By [mailto:ecolson@ix.netcom.com Eric Olson]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/dark/small/squabblingdelegates.html</ref>

This is the ultimate utility card for your senatorial needs. If you're using the new objective [[My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal{{!}}My Lord, Is That Legal?]], you'll want to use multiples of this card to get your key senators and their bodyguards, [[Coruscant (Dark) (Coruscant){{!}}Coruscant]] Guards, out. And once you have all the key characters you need at the senate, this doubles as late-game force retrieval.

But you can also use this in a non-senate deck to get a key senator on a matching effect. For example, you can use [[Squabbling Delegates]] to get [[Orn Free Taa]] to put on [[Motion Supported]] and get a very useful ability, all without needing the Galactic Senate.
